Source-only dependency bundle for the Esparto ebuild of ZapFast 0.21.3.

Contains 808 registry crates from upstream's Cargo.lock, verified against their
original SHA-256 checksums. GitHub Actions regenerates the archive and checks
it against the SHA-256 reviewed locally. This is not an application binary.

Pinned Git dependencies are fetched separately by the ebuild. Original source
and license files are included. See SHA256SUMS for the archive checksum.

Bundle SHA-256: 0e8262a3bc680579e05bbbdf0e2f27a7b98b737290706c10d52a0839e40c06b5
